# SC3042: effect-error-mapping-type

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for effect error mapping type. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Correct the route path, parameter binding, schema, or redirect associated with `effect-error-mapping-type`. Keep request and response contracts explicit and status-specific.

## Reproduction
